about:
Austen Morris Custom Furniture operates from Mt Rainier, Maryland, in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. The studio was founded in 2020 and functions as a design and build workshop focused on handcrafted hardwood furniture. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces made-to-order furniture using premium hardwoods and natural finishes, employing a blend of traditional and modern joinery techniques. Since its inception, the studio has completed more than 175 unique pieces, offering both fully custom designs and a curated collection. No facility size, headcount, or equipment list is published.

Clients include homeowners, interior designers, architects, and retailers seeking custom furniture solutions. The studio collaborates directly with each group to develop pieces tailored to specific spaces and requirements.

The founders emphasize an approach that combines experience with flexibility, describing their work as "highly crafted and deeply human." The studio positions its blend of traditional craftsmanship and contemporary design as its distinguishing characteristic.
